paras.text: There is a difference between Pakistani culture and world culture. Pakistani culture is a collection of many group cultures. On the basis of the mutual relationship and dependence of all ethnicities a new national culture has come into being, which has been given the name of Pakistani culture. To bind these different cultures together religious values are of importance. In Pakistani culture problems like intolerance, non-acceptance and lack of forbearance exist. There is a lack of equality and class life has come into being. In this culture economic interests have priority, and the national culture revolves around the economic interests of different ethnicities.

Difference in Pakistani and International Culture With Reference to Diversity

There is a difference between Pakistani culture and world culture. Pakistani culture is a collection of many group cultures. On the basis of the mutual relationship and dependence of all ethnicities a new national culture has come into being, which has been given the name of Pakistani culture. To bind these different cultures together religious values are of importance. In Pakistani culture problems like intolerance, non-acceptance and lack of forbearance exist. There is a lack of equality and class life has come into being. In this culture economic interests have priority, and the national culture revolves around the economic interests of different ethnicities.

Diversity cannot be ended in Pakistani society, but it should be kept within the limit of tolerance. Similarly this diversity should be used positively for healthy competition. In international culture those problems are not found which are seen in Pakistani culture. At the world level every nation has the right to live and develop according to its wishes, desires, priorities and likes and dislikes. No nation can be compelled to adopt some particular culture. At the world level the form of diversity is positive, and the more it is, the more the world will develop because of competition in a healthy manner. In Surah Al-Hujurat of the Holy Qur’an there is the divine saying that We created people from one man and one woman and then divided them into tribes and nations so that they may be recognised. Therefore the development of world diversity is the cause of identity and recognition. Instead of ending this diversity there is a need to strengthen it, and this is also the wish of the United Nations and other world institutions. However, the purpose of the development of these individual cultures should not be domination or obtaining supremacy and superiority over others. Today there is a need for dialogue to end the differences between world civilisations and cultures and to understand one another. paras.urdu: عالمی سطح پر تنوع (اُجاگر کرنے کی ضرورت) (Need for Celeberating Diversity at Global Level)
paras.pashto: په نړیواله کچه د تنوع د لمانځلو اړتیا

paras.text: Diversity in international culture is the name of the collection of different kinds of human societies or cultures. This world is populated by people of different ethnicities, languages, customs and religions. Each has its own culture, but despite this individuality they are also living in this world and it is not possible for them to travel alone. In this way, from their mutual meeting world culture is formed, whose foundation is diversity. Anthropologists believe that humans were born in Africa two million years ago and gradually spread in the world. As Muslims our belief is that first of all in the world Hazrat Adam (peace be upon him) and Hazrat Hawwa Bibi appeared. The offspring of both of them spread in the world. The source of humans is one. Keeping one’s individuality, there is a need for unity and agreement and mutual help and cooperation, and this is possible by recognising and highlighting diversity.

paras.text: The General Assembly of the United Nations, through a resolution, fixed 21 May for celebrating this day. The United Nations encouraged every international effort with reference to cultural diversity. Need for Celebrating Diversity at Global Level

Diversity in international culture is the name of the collection of different kinds of human societies or cultures. This world is populated by people of different ethnicities, languages, customs and religions. Each has its own culture, but despite this individuality they are also living in this world and it is not possible for them to travel alone. In this way, from their mutual meeting world culture is formed, whose foundation is diversity. Anthropologists believe that humans were born in Africa two million years ago and gradually spread in the world. As Muslims our belief is that first of all in the world Hazrat Adam (peace be upon him) and Hazrat Hawwa Bibi appeared. The offspring of both of them spread in the world. The source of humans is one. Keeping one’s individuality, there is a need for unity and agreement and mutual help and cooperation, and this is possible by recognising and highlighting diversity.

The General Assembly of the United Nations, through a resolution, fixed 21 May for celebrating this day. The United Nations encouraged every international effort with reference to cultural diversity. If at the world level experts and institutions agree on celebrating diversity, then it means that there is good for humanity in it.

The need for celebrating diversity at the world level is very important. We cannot establish a world free from diversity, and we have to live in this world where diversity is an essential matter. Ending someone’s individuality is not possible, nor is it the demand of justice. From this, nationalities get the opportunity to strengthen their individuality and identity. From this every individual, institution, group and state gets the opportunity to adopt the culture of its choice and to make it strong. This world is a garden of different flowers in which every nation is like a different flower. The different shape, style and colour of every flower is the cause of the beauty of the garden.
